name: Delta
card: The county seat between Grand Junction and Montrose, with a strong agricultural base.
near: It sits on US-50 between those two larger cities.
metaTitle: Delta, Colorado Websites and Local SEO | Nick Perry Digital
metaDescription: Websites and local SEO for Delta, Colorado businesses. Clear prices for the site build and monthly plans.
body:
Delta is the seat of Delta County and a working town between two larger markets. Customers may compare you with Grand Junction or Montrose companies that are willing to drive.

The site should say whether you stay in Delta County or cover the whole stretch. I would rather be specific than claim every city on US-50.
extraQ: We are between two bigger cities. Where should the site aim?
extraA: Start with Delta and the county, then add the other cities only if you will take the drive. A page aimed at everyone in western Colorado ranks for no one in particular.
